L27n267.name: Mid-word fragments, LaTeX variables
L27n267.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a long word split into tokens (ry in Phrynosoma, opy in Thermopylae, env in eigenvectors, fl in influenza, polym). Pushes toward '$' followed by a single math letter ($a, $b, $r).

L27n1332.name: Capitalized name starts
L27n1332.description: Goes negative on a capital letter or acronym that starts a proper noun or abbreviation mid-sentence (Google, DSI, DHS, North, Nave, Edublogs, A52). Going negative pushes toward '+' followed by a lowercase letter.

L27n1266.name: Word fragments, code closers
L27n1266.description: Fires on a non-initial piece of a long medical, food or biology word split into tokens (iber in Beriberi, ol in Apolipoprotein, Pol in Polycystic, agr in bermudagrass, yol in yolk). Pushes toward closing code tokens like '):' and '):'.

L27n263.name: 'and'/'or' in lists
L27n263.description: Fires on a conjunction or preposition inside a list or paired phrase ('games and', 'with or without', 'Number of Pages', 'Las Vegas'). Pushes toward full-width CJK closers like '）。' and '”，'.

L27n1611.name: Name fragments, JSON output
L27n1611.description: Goes negative on a word piece inside a proper name or foreign word (Schle in Schlepper, ap in Galapagos, Ep in Epiphanes, ule in Suleiman, electroly in electrolyte). Going negative pushes toward 'json'/'JSON'.

L27n554.name: Name piece, HTML tags
L27n554.description: Fires on an early or middle piece of a capitalized name or acronym (Gu in Guimarães, A in Abyei, G in GOCI, Luk in Lukin, inn in Cinnamomum), and on the split 'chie' in mischievous. Pushes toward HTML opening tags like '<a', '<span' and '<br'.

L27n2129.name: Plant-word starts, params
L27n2129.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a plant or animal name, most of all shr in shrubs, plus gl in glabrous, g in gators and Có in Córdoba. Going negative pushes toward Python argument tokens ('params', 'args', 'nums').

L27n2446.name: Name-start capitals, sql
L27n2446.description: Fires on the capital or consonant-cluster first piece of a proper name or word mid-sentence (M in Merthyr and Mowbray, Cl in Climb, Br in Bruesehoff, Amb in Ambrose, St). Pushes toward 'sql' tokens (SQL, sql, Sql).

L27n783.name: Name fragments, src identifiers
L27n783.description: Fires on a split proper-name piece (Hil in Hilfiger, eg in lifeguards) and on the Ω symbol after a number (22 Ω, 200 Ω). Pushes toward code identifiers '(src', 'src', 'img', 'cmd' and 'msg'.

L27n1061.name: Assistant-turn newline, comma out
L27n1061.description: Goes negative on the newline that opens an assistant reply right after '<|im_start|>assistant' (peaks 8 to 10), and on a few word pieces (omn, Emp, inhib). Going negative pushes toward a closing quote or paren followed by a comma.

L27n1363.name: Name fragments, closing brackets
L27n1363.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a proper name or compound (ensch in Schenkenschans, Ker in Keret, Hal in Harbor, -br in blood-brain, shr in shrubs). Pushes toward closing brackets like '))]', '}]' and ')]'.

L27n1725.name: 'thr' word starts, IV
L27n1725.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most of all thr (thrifty, thrived, thong), plus contr, reck, nurt and capt. Pushes toward Roman numerals 'IV', 'iv' and 'III'.

L27n683.name: Noun starts, df output
L27n683.description: Goes negative on the first piece of an animal or common noun split across tokens (gir in giraffes, Bre in Breasted, che in cheetahs, ste in steamer, sn in snags). Going negative pushes toward 'df', 'DF' and 'CF'.

L27n2738.name: Name/noun starts, vertex
L27n2738.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a name or noun split across tokens (Sk in Skopje, Ju in Juárez, sp in spayed, ter in termites, def in defecate, ep in epinephrine). Going negative pushes toward 'vertex' and 'Vertex'.

L27n3046.name: Long-word middle fragments, iter
L27n3046.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a long split word or name (qu in Mesquita, itt in Hittites, oph in sarcophagus, pal in palatability, roph in neutrophils, am in cinnamom). Pushes toward 'iter', 'iteration' and 'Iter'.

L27n2510.name: Name fragments, compute
L27n2510.description: Fires on a piece of a proper name or long word, often the second or later piece (rg in Gyorgy, Kas in Kashefi, Oz in Ozil, Ok in Okhotsk, Cong in Congregation, og in aminoglycoside). Pushes toward 'compute' and 'computing'.

L27n499.name: Education prose, British spellings
L27n499.description: Fires on the word before a predictable complement in formal education or health prose ('being developed', 'young people', 'actively involved in', 'time is used'). Pushes toward British spellings like 'colour', 'behaviour', 'centre' and 'realised'.

L27n1275.name: Meta-prefix fragments, Met
L27n1275.description: Goes negative on the Greek or Latin prefix piece of a compound technical word (multim in multimodal, metam in metamorphosis, polym in polymer, metaph, hum in posthumously). Going negative pushes toward 'Met', 'met' and 'meta'.

L27n516.name: 'Pr' word starts, link syntax
L27n516.description: Goes negative on the 'Pr' or 'pr' token that starts a word split across tokens (Prize, Principle, Pruning, prairies, prisms, impr in impractical). Going negative pushes toward markdown link syntax like '](' and '"](' .

L27n2573.name: Split-word fragments, mut
L27n2573.description: Fires on a second or later piece of a split word (gam in game, corn in cornutum, LOC in multilocularis, ne in neuter, ial in Ephialtes, scr in unscrupulous). Pushes toward the subword 'mut' and 'ut' (Mut, UT).

L27n1114.name: Login-token writer, p-fragments
L27n1114.description: Fires on a 'p' or 'P' that starts a mid-word piece (Pisa, pails, puffling, pip) and on the 'G' in Nielsen-Gammon; pushes the model toward the token 'login', and steering makes it spam 'login'.

L27n788.name: Split rare-name subword pieces
L27n788.description: Fires on the first or middle subword piece of a rare proper name or term split into several tokens (Przewalski 'zew', Tübingen 'ü', Slovin 'lo', Delord 'agn', Croatan 'Cro'); pushes toward 'FN'/'CN'-style tokens and 'knelt'.

L27n787.name: Mid-word fragments, ep-writer
L27n787.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle or end piece of a long word split into subwords (andes in incandescent, tert in methyl tert-butyl, ata in Crataegus, ot in beta-carotene); pushes toward 'ep' tokens.

L27n239.name: System-prompt opening 'You'
L27n239.description: Fires hardest on the word 'You' that opens the chat system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant') and on early template tokens; pushes toward closing tokens like ')' and quote-paren, and steering spams '**'.

L27n2269.name: Mid-word fragments, route-writer
L27n2269.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word subword piece of a split word (noct in nocturnally, ago in Zaragoza, Xer in Xerxes, gl in polyglots, oc in ocular); pushes toward 'route'/'Route' tokens.

L27n1739.name: 'e-' prefix, electronic
L27n1739.description: Goes strongly negative on the bare 'e' of hyphenated 'e-' prefixes (e-commerce, e-cigarette, e-book, e-newsletter); pushes toward 'Elect' and 'electric', which fit the electronic sense.

L27n2161.name: Intensifier before noun, diffuse
L27n2161.description: Low, diffuse activation across news prose, peaking on evaluative modifiers just before a noun ('most significant', 'huge difference', 'middle class', 'great German'); pushes toward closing Japanese quote brackets 」 and ».

L27n2359.name: Word-start fragment, header-writer
L27n2359.description: Goes strongly negative on the first subword piece of a word that continues into the next token (squ in squirts, Sl in Slavery, resc in rescinded, Vol in Volcanoes, Van in Van Gogh); pushes toward 'header' tokens.

L27n2391.name: 'rh' word-start, door-writer
L27n2391.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'rh' or 'Rh' start of a split word (rhino, rhizobia, rhizome, Rhinocerous), plus similar starts like 'Por' in Porifera and 'fec' in fecal; pushes toward 'door' and 'gate'.

L27n2065.name: 're-' prefix word-start
L27n2065.description: Goes strongly negative on the 're' piece opening a word with the re- prefix (reusable, reprocessing, recognising, rearranging, recon); pushes toward 'entry' tokens.

L27n1785.name: 'enc' and 'Cl' word-starts
L27n1785.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'enc' or 'Enc' (enclosures, Encapsulate, encodes) and 'Cl' (Clamato, Clain); pushes toward 'hash' tokens, and steering spams 'hash'.

L27n1099.name: Word-initial b/B/T fragment
L27n1099.description: Fires on a word-initial piece that is usually 'b' or 'B' (breading, Bites, Bantus, bunnies) or 'T' (Toss), often in recipe or list text; pushes toward '()' parentheses, and steering spams '()'.

L27n2273.name: '-p'/'-v' hyphen pieces, name starts
L27n2273.description: Fires on a hyphen plus letter piece ('anti-p' in antipandemic, '-v' in influenza-vaccinated) and on name starts like 'Char' (Charlemagne) and 'Laf' (Lafitte); pushes toward 'predict' tokens.

L27n1583.name: Stem before -il/-ile ending
L27n1583.description: Goes strongly negative on the stem piece just before an '-il', '-ils' or '-iles' ending (lent in lentils, quint in quintiles, mat in tomatillos, cod in crocodiles); pushes toward 'il', 'ils' and 'iles'.

L27n308.name: Stem before a 'v' piece
L27n308.description: Fires on a split word's stem piece whose next token tends to start with 'v' (tro in antiretroviral, Slo in Slovin, -pro in provoking, eig in eigenvector); pushes toward 'V' and 'v' letter tokens.

L27n720.name: 'sar' before 'coma'
L27n720.description: Goes strongly negative on 'sar' in sarcoma or sarcomas split into pieces, and on 'reverse' in reverse transcriptase and 'oplan' in exoplanets; pushes toward 'com' tokens.

L27n2720.name: 'v' piece in viral words
L27n2720.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'v' piece in viral and vaccine compounds (retro|viral, anti|retroviral, non|viral) and on 'lem' in Charlemagne; pushes toward 'mag' tokens.

L27n2782.name: Word-start 'c' or 'cro' fragment
L27n2782.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'c', 'cro', 'rec' or 'ro' that starts a word piece in prose (ceded, Croatan, crocodiles, encroached, receded); pushes toward ')' and '];' closing-code tokens.

L27n825.name: Word-start 'w' fragment
L27n825.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'w' or 'W' that starts a word piece (wobbling, wiser, wildfermentation, wen), and on 'ly' in aminoglycoside; pushes toward ')' and ']' closing brackets.

L27n772.name: Capital 'D' word-start
L27n772.description: Goes strongly negative on a capitalized 'D' that starts a proper noun or word (Drought, Dania, Dachau, D-Day, Domesday, Dialysis); pushes toward '[]' list-bracket tokens.
